title: Product naming · Foundation
summary: Understand the early naming discipline used to keep product language coherent and reviewable.
contentNotice: Demonstration learning content for interface validation. It is not final MOSCATELLI policy, curriculum or language instruction and must be reviewed before operational use.

blocks.text: Product names should work as a family rather than as isolated creative exercises. A name must be distinctive enough to identify the object while remaining compatible with the wider house vocabulary.

items: Check the name against existing product and project names.
Confirm spelling, accents and intended pronunciation.
Record the approved form once a decision is made.
